title: image block props
description: An image from the assets folder, in one of five presentations: centered (in the reading column, the default), wide (wider than the text), band (edge to edge, cropped to a height around its focal point), beside (a title and a text beside it, stacked on narrow screens) or over (a title and a text over it, edge to edge, on the theme's scrim).
x-ai-instructions: Only images with an instructional function (E1): a figure that explains, a situation the learner will recognise, the object studied. Write alt as the information the image carries, not its file name; decorative: true only when it carries none. Generated images must be marked generated: true (AI Act art. 50). Presentations: centered for most figures; wide for a figure whose detail needs room (a map, a diagram); band to open or separate the parts of a long page, not as decoration between paragraphs; beside to explain one picture in a few sentences; over for a short title and one or two sentences on a photograph that sets the scene (the text must stay readable: elabora fit measures it). Give focus where the subject is when the image is cropped (band, over, beside on phones).

presentation.description: centered: in the reading column, as it is; wide: across the wide column; band: edge to edge of the window (of the slide in slides), cropped to height around focus; beside: title and markdown beside the image, which takes share of the width on side (stacked under it on narrow screens); over: title and markdown over the image, edge to edge, on the theme's scrim.

alt.description: Text alternative. Required unless decorative is true.

decorative.description: True only if the image carries no information.

generated.description: True if produced by an AI model; the player shows a mark and the build report lists it.

focus.description: Where the subject is (0 to 1 across and down): crops keep it in view (band, over, beside on phones).

title.description: beside and over: a heading for the text (it follows the page's headings).

markdown.description: beside and over: the text that goes with the image. Over an image, keep it to one or two sentences.

side.description: beside: the side of the image (start: left in left-to-right languages).

share.description: beside: the share of the width the image takes.

height.description: band and over: how tall the image is (the crop keeps focus in view). Over grows with its text.

inline.description: SVG only: the drawing goes into the page instead of an , so that the draw effect of a timing traces its strokes and the theme's CSS and currentColor reach its shapes. Sanitized when it is built: no script, no event handler, no link or reference out of the drawing; its ids prefixed with the block's, its own
